part.text: Perfect! I can see the "Search" button in the bottom navigation bar. According to the accessibility tree, it's located at coordinates (0.212, 0.905) with dimensions (0.192, 0.055). Let me tap on the center of this button.

Excellent! I've successfully opened the Search/Explore tab in the Bluesky app. The screen now displays the Explore page with:

- A search bar at the top ("Search for posts, users, or feeds")
- "Your interests" section
- "Discover new feeds" section
- "Suggested accounts" section with category tabs (For You, Art, Video Games, Sports, etc.)

The magnifying glass icon in the bottom navigation is now active, confirming that the Search/Explore tab is open. The task is complete.
